1981 · Political leader · Aircraft crash

Jaime Roldós Aguilera

Roldós promoted a regional human-rights doctrine and policies that conflicted with military regimes and powerful energy interests. His death changed Ecuador's leadership and weakened a regional human-rights initiative.

1981 · Political leader · Aircraft crash

Omar Torrijos

Torrijos had negotiated control of the Panama Canal and pursued a nationalist foreign policy independent of Washington. His death altered Panama's succession and eventually helped create conditions for Manuel Noriega's rise.

1981 · Inventor · Energy technology

Tom Ogle

Ogle claimed to have developed a fuel-vapour system capable of dramatically increasing vehicle mileage and was seeking commercial backing. The case became a central legend in suppressed-energy technology narratives.
